headline: Operation Safe Harbour — Complete
message:
You now understand the legal framework that makes ethical security research possible.

The line between Priya and Marcus was not skill, not discovery, not intent. It was discipline — the discipline to access only what was necessary, to contact the vendor before publishing, and to follow a professional process rather than acting on impulse.

Every security professional who builds a long career builds it on exactly this foundation: knowing the law, understanding what authorisation actually requires, and treating responsible disclosure not as an optional courtesy but as a professional obligation.

Grey hat is not a career path. White hat — with written authorisation, defined scope, and professional disclosure standards — is the only sustainable way to do this work.
